inlineSql: SELECT A.DESIGN_NO,A.VCH_DATE,A.CO_BOOK,B.AC_NAME FROM MFG_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE And A.AC_CODE = B.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE= ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND DESIGN_NO <> '' ? AND A.ENTRY_TYPE = ' ? ' ? AND A.VCH_DATE >= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? '

And A.DESIGN_NO NOT IN (SELECT C.DESIGN_NO FROM MFG_DETL AS C INNER JOIN BAR_DETL AS D ON C.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE AND C.LC_CODE = D.LC_CODE AND C.DESIGN_NO = D.DESIGN_NO WHERE C.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND C.LC_CODE = ' ? ')

And A.DESIGN_NO IN (SELECT C.DESIGN_NO FROM MFG_DETL AS C INNER JOIN BAR_DETL AS D ON C.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE AND C.LC_CODE = D.LC_CODE AND C.DESIGN_NO = D.DESIGN_NO WHERE C.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND C.LC_CODE = ' ? ')
SELECT C.DESIGN_NO FROM MFG_DETL AS C INNER JOIN BAR_DETL AS D ON C.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE AND C.LC_CODE = D.LC_CODE AND C.DESIGN_NO = D.DESIGN_NO WHERE C.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND C.LC_CODE = ' ? '

SELECT A.VCH_DATE,A.CO_BOOK,A.VCH_NO,A.SR_NO,A.DESIGN_NO,A.IT_CODE As ItCode,A.ITM_PCS,A.ITM_GWT,A.ITM_NWT,A.ITM_FINE,E.AC_NAME AS KrName,B.BOOK_SNAME,B.MAIN_BOOK,A.ITM_OTH_WT,A.KR_KUNDAN_WT,A.KR_WAX_WT,A.OTH_AMT FROM (MFG_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.CO_BOOK = B.CO_BOOK)LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS E ON A.CO_CODE = E.CO_CODE AND A.AC_CODE = E.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.DESIGN_NO = ' ? ' ? UNION ALL SELECT C.VCH_DATE,C.CO_BOOK,C.VCH_NO,C.SR_NO,C.DESIGN_NO,C.IT_CODE,C.ITM_PCS,C.ITM_GWT,C.KR_NWT AS ITM_NWT,C.KR_FINE AS ITM_FINE,F.AC_NAME,D.BOOK_SNAME,D.MAIN_BOOK,C.ITM_GWT-C.ITM_NWT,0,0,C.OTH_AMT FROM (MAIN_STOCK AS C LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS D ON C.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE AND C.LC_CODE = D.LC_CODE AND C.CO_BOOK = D.CO_BOOK)LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS F ON C.CO_CODE = F.CO_CODE AND C.AC_CODE = F.AC_CODE WHERE C.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND C.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND C.DESIGN_NO = ' ? ' ORDER BY A.VCH_DATE
Select * From USER_SET WHERE LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND USER_NAME = ' ? ' AND SUB_MENU = ' ? '
Select BOOK_NAME ,CO_BOOK ,BOOK_TYPE,ITM_TYPE,MAIN_BOOK,BOOK_SNAME,BOOK_INOUT,MENU_NAME FROM BOOK_DATA WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_BOOK = ' ? '
Select * From AC_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND AC_CODE = ' ? '

SELECT B.AC_NAME As AcNameL,A.AC_CODE As AcCodeL,B.AC_GR AS GroupL,B.AC_ADD1 As AddressL,B.AC_PHONE As PhoneL,B.AC_MOBILE As MobileL FROM MFG_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_CODE = B.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' GROUP BY B.AC_NAME,A.AC_CODE,B.AC_GR,B.AC_ADD1,B.AC_PHONE,B.AC_MOBILE ORDER BY B.AC_NAME
Select A.DESIGN_NO FROM MFG_DETL AS A WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.DESIGN_NO = ' ? '

Select A.DESIGN_NO AS DesignNoL,B.IT_NAME As ItNameL,A.IT_CODE as ItCodeL FROM MFG_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.DESIGN_NO <> '' GROUP BY A.DESIGN_NO,B.IT_NAME,A.IT_CODE ORDER BY A.DESIGN_NO
